title: logfold mask set
description: A mask set file for --masks-file and the built-in sets: a named, versioned list of masking rules. The file is data only and at most 1 MiB; at most 256 rules; the name of the file does not matter.

version.description: Raise it when the rules change; a saved state is refused when the rules differ.

rules.description: Tried in one pass, the earliest rule wins at one position; they run before the default masks.

pattern.description: A regular expression of the linear-time engine (no look-around, no back-references); it must not match the empty string. Inline flags must be scoped, (?i:...).

token.description: The replacement; the default masks must not change it.

check.description: A match that fails the check is skipped and the search goes on one byte later.
